jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? No fear of heights?? At least a high school diploma?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail?? You are physically fit and enjoy active work?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Our client is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Junior Associate with a strong interest in the financial sector and an affinity for IT and digital solutions to join its Operations department.
The Operations department consists of approximately 60 colleagues based in Brussels and manages a broad range of services related to banking products and transactions.
These activities include post-trade processing, cash and payment services, portfolio transfers, tax services, income and corporate actions, and account administration.

 
As an Operations – Cash & Payments Junior Associate, you will: 

 
• Process payment and treasury transactions accurately and efficiently, ensuring high-quality data and excellent service to both internal and external clients. 
 
• Perform operational support activities based on scheduled or ad hoc requests, including account closures, interest adjustments, reconciliation as well as investigation and controls on transactions 
 
• Contribute to the development and implementation of new processes and systems, as well as the continuous improvement of existing ones, with the aim of increasing efficiency, complying with new regulations and market standards, and reducing operational risk. 
 
• Proactively follow and integrate operational and procedural changes to keep your knowledge and expertise up to date. 
 
• Participate in knowledge sharing and training, both receiving training from colleagues and sharing your own expertise across the department. 

 
• A Master's degree or equivalent experience, preferably within the financial sector. 
 
• French or Dutch as your main language, combined with a very good command of the other national language and English. 
 
• A collaborative mindset and a genuine willingness to learn and share knowledge. 
 
• A dynamic, proactive and confident personality. 
 
• A strong client-focused mindset and good communication skills. 
 
• Strong analytical skills, combined with the ability to synthesize complex information. 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and strong general digital skills.

For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.
Responsibilities

• Help define, implement and maintain highly available, performant & scalable database systems to effectively meet IT Business requirements

• Be involved in deployment and patching automation

• Maintain (backups, transaction log management, index optimisation etc) and upgrade the database systems etc

• Review database schema changes to ensure compliance with standards and ensure optimal choice of indexing, column definitions etc.

• Help with problem solving in case of performance problems or functional issues in applications

• Build a strong relationship both within the infrastructure team and with the development teams

• Promote best practices

• Maintain the deployment pipeline

Additional details

Seniority: Medior/Senior

Start Date: October/November

Duration: Long-term

Extension: Yes

Contract: Freelance

Location: Brussels

Onsite Policy: 50%

Hours Per Week: 40

Languages: Fluent English and French/Dutch

Interview Process: 1 stage

• Expert knowledge of SQL Server administration, performance tuning, high availability and disaster recovery

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle and enterprise database operations

• Hands-on experience with AWS database services (Aurora, RDS for SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL, DynamoDB)

• Experience with Azure database services (Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, CosmosDB)

• Strong troubleshooting skills across database, operating system and infrastructure layers

• Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation

• Good knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Red Hat Linux

 

Strongly preferred:

• Experience with TerraForm, Ansible or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools

• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Redgate , Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or equivalent

• Experience modernising legacy database platforms

• Experience with GIT, Jira and CI/CD-driven deployment processes

• Experience with cloud security, encryption, backup and disaster recovery solutions

• Experience with performance monitoring and capacity management in cloud environments

• Knowledge of Power BI, SSAS or reporting platforms

 

Nice to have:

• VMware vSphere and ESXi administration knowledge

• CommVault or enterprise backup solutions

• Basic networking and load-balancing (F5) concepts

• Azure Entra ID and Azure platform services

• Basic knowledge of Go or Python programming language

Soft skills

• Good communication skills enabling you to explain complex technical issues is an easy-to-understand way

• Like to keep up to date with the latest technology trends

• Fluent English and good knowledge of either French or Dutch

• Advanced investigation & problem solving skills with strong analytical skills

• Availability & flexibility

• Interested in cloud technologies and what the future may bring

• Have a clean certificate of good behaviour

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.
What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, MicroServices, RESTful APIs

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus

• A Togaf certification, or a similar one

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, Mainframe backends and SaaS packages

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow

• Fluent English

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment

• Knowledge of capital markets

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture

Department of Biomedical Sciences – Trypanosoma Unit 
 

For a more detailed research context, please refer to the PDF document.
 

Your role:
 

 · Develop an innovative and internationally competitive research programme on trypanosomes, with a strong foundation in fundamental parasite biology and/or host–parasite–vector interactions.
 

· Develop, apply and disseminate state-of-the-art experimental approaches in fundamental research, which may include advanced molecular biology, biochemistry, imaging, cell biology, multi-omics and/or computational methods, according to the candidate’s expertise and research interest.
 

· Be willing to take responsibility for and further develop the unit’s existing translational and applied research portfolio, including its contribution to HAT diagnosis, molecular surveillance and control programmes, as well as the scientific use and maintenance of its tsetse fly facility.
 

· Establish and foster strong global partnerships and collaborations.
 

· Acquire competitive research funding and build up international reputation and visibility.
 

· Contribute actively to the development and delivery of the educational portfolio of the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM, including supervision of Master students and PhD training.
 

· Build and lead a team of scientific and technical staff, take up management responsibilities appropriate to the academic level.
 

· Collaborate with other units in the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM to develop complementary research lines on vector-borne and protozoan diseases.
 

· Contribute expertise to national and international bodies and stakeholders, where relevant to the candidate’s field.
 

· Oversee and direct ITM’s WHO Collaborating Centre for Research and Training on Human African Trypanosomiasis Diagnostics.
 

· Promote and contribute to the strategic vision of the department and to relevant ITM committees.

Profile / Requirements
 

· A PhD degree in biology, veterinary sciences, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, medicine, or equivalent field. 
 

· An excellent research profile in experimental/molecular parasitology of Trypanosomatids. 
 

· Experience with advanced experimental and/or computational approaches relevant to the proposed research programme. 
 

· A proven track record of successful grant writing and project supervision, in accordance with the candidate’s career stage. 
 

· A collaborative scientific profile and ability to develop interdisciplinary and international collaborations. 
 

· Experience in translational or applied research, capacity strengthening, and collaboration with institutions in endemic countries is considered an asset. 
 

· Prior experience in running a tsetse fly facility is not essential, though an interest in helping to run and utilize the tsetse facilities is considered an asset. 
 

· Experience in academic teaching and training in the field of parasitology is highly valued. 
 

· Excellent communication skills and respectful people management skills. 
 

· Fluent in English. Knowledge of French is an asset. Active knowledge of Dutch is desirable. If you do not have these skills, willingness to acquire a working level of Dutch is requested. 
 

· You support the mission and values of the ITM.

You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

To support our further growth ambitions, brantsandpatents is looking for
 a Patent Advisor or (partially qualified) European Patent Attorney with a background in chemistry, preferable organic chemistry.
 

As a Patent Advisor, you will analyze the R&D activities of your clients and advise them on how to protect their innovations through an appropriate IP strategy, which you will then put into practice.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors, -attorneys and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You’ll work from our office in Ghent.
 

 

You have or are...
 
 

• A master’s degree (MSc) in chemistry, chemical engineering or similar, with a strong preference for organic chemistry. A PhD is a nice to have. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English. 

• Interest in legal principles and patent law. 

• The ambition and drive to build a career in IP and to qualify as a patent attorney.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.
